about_the_game:
Night Fantasy is a SRPG that combines roguelike deck-building with tactical strategy gameplay.
In a world shrouded by eternal night, players will lead three adventurers to climb the Demon Tower, defeat the Demon Lord, and bring long-lost light back to the land.
Each adventure starts from zero. As the journey progresses, you will continuously collect skills, classes, talents, and relics to build a unique team of heroes.

Key Features

  • Tactics meets Roguelike: Grid-based battles combined with random progression for a unique experience.

  • Multi-action excitement: Characters can act multiple times in a single turn, creating fast-paced and thrilling combat.

  • Multi-layered growth: Skills, spirits, ultimates, and talents can be freely combined to form diverse playstyles.

  • Classes and promotions: Progress from basic to advanced classes to unlock deeper tactical possibilities.

  • High replayability: Random routes and diverse events ensure every adventure feels fresh.

Gameplay Overview

  • Three-person squad: Control three characters at once, spending RAP (action points) to perform multiple actions.

  • Battlefield strategy: Terrain, enemy placement, and turn order have a major impact on tactics.

  • Relics and items: Relics grant lasting benefits to the entire team, while items must be used wisely depending on the situation.

Combat Elements

  • Normal attack: Reliable and scales well over time.

  • Skills: Actively cast abilities with varied functions.

  • Spirits: Provide healing, shields, and buffs.

  • Ultimates: Wide-ranged, powerful abilities that can turn the tide of battle.

  • Talents: Permanent passives that shape personalized combat styles.

Meta-Progression

  • Random routes: Encounter battles, events, shops, and bosses throughout the journey.

  • Growth and building: Earn new abilities after victories to gradually expand team combinations.

  • Risk and choice: Every run brings opportunities and dangers, ensuring long-term replay value.
